dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. Ordinary conversation beside the ring.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: Three coins on the long legs. No, two. The third is for supper.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: Do not look at me like that. I have already lost supper once.

description: A sailor beside the ring reduces a three-coin bet to two because the third coin is for supper; he admits having lost supper once already. During the cargo errand Harker calls for Venn to return the unopened oil tin, and a sailor carries it back toward the east lot. This fixed harbour resident is not automatically the same person as a generated ring challenger who happens to draw the name Venn. His betting is background dialogue, not a player betting feature.
name: Venn
